_note: The fixed opening cluster (DESIGN.md "Fixed opening cluster", M9.1): placed first and identical on every seed. Positions are metres from home's centre (dx east, dz south); home sits on the cliff at config.map.cluster.homeX. key: an encounter id from encounters.json, or a sigil ground id from sigilGrounds.json with kind "sigilGround". clearingType: homeWoods keeps checkpoint and roadside mixes out of the cluster, so its sigils raise citizens (Session 11). paths: the cluster's pathways (the only ones north of the cordon); the frontier joins at the outpost alone, through the checkpoint. They make a loop, so the dead and the witch reach the shelter side without walking through the station.
